source_conclusions: Home specialization uses a fixed alias list and exact accessibility identifiers; targets, list and overlay must each be unique. Ordinary controls retain existing behavior.

Finite positive target/list/app/overlay rectangles share screen coordinates. The entire list and overlay must lie in the app rectangle; the entire card must lie in the list; the card must not intersect the overlay expanded by eight points. Foreground, no alert and no keyboard are required.

At most 24 geometry samples, six consecutive samples relative to the first retained anchor, all four frames within existing 0.5-point tolerance. Invalid or moving observations reset the streak. Existing nonblocking 0.25-second runloop intervals separate samples. Final current geometry and actual target frame are rechecked before tapping.

After all scroll gestures, the observer display must start at exactly {}; one real l08-ui-observe tap must publish a nonempty closed four-key Int dictionary and all counters must be zero. No direct Kotlin callback or property injection supplies the observation.

The existing target.tap occurs exactly once. Afterward at most 24 real read-only l08-ui-observe taps may poll; resume and recovery counters must be 0..1, retry/discard must remain zero, and success returns only on resume_taps == 1. A stale zero can delay or fail but cannot pass. Unchanged monotonic private-set counters prevent stale preactivation one acceptance.

JSONDecoder enforces Int values; input is <=1024 bytes with exact known keys. Invalid or missing counters produce a bounded closed failure diagnostic before failure, never defaults. Six-sample geometry and postactivation timeout fail closed.

New diagnostics expose only closed aliases/phases, public geometry, bounded counters and validity flags; each row is <=2048 bytes. They explicitly state proves_recovery=false. No labels, private player state, exception descriptions, screenshots or arbitrary UI dumps are added.

The existing 13-boot storage method, storage assertions, retry/discard flow, three retained-host fixture callers, Kotlin seam/observer, production Home callback, card, and strict storage comparisons are not changed by this fixture correction.
Host-only authority, protocol 4.2, deterministic seeds, privacy boundaries, Doctor ON/OFF behavior, strict snapshot/content validation and Leave-confirmation timing remain untouched.
